The topsoil was wetter than 90% of the same month in 1996-2025 when last measured (15 Oct), so more of the rain is likely to run off. 25 Oct: 25.2 mm (46.8 mm over three days) against a usual worst of 17.58 mm in a day and 38.45 mm over three days. 26 Oct: 67.2 mm (99.6 mm over three days) against a usual worst of 17.58 mm in a day and 38.45 mm over three days.
evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-10-18, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Quito, Pichincha, Ecuador, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
verificationRule: Checked against the rainfall NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
